column1: # Which ref command line each benchmark runs. PI rule (2026-08-04): exactly ONE line
# per benchmark, defaulting to SPEC's first (index 0); escalate to a longer line only
# when index 0 is too short to complete one full 11-group rotation (11 groups x WINSEC; 55 s at WINSEC=5).
# Any row here is a deliberate deviation and must carry a reason.
# 2026-08-05: ALL NINE escalations retired. At WINSEC=0.1 a rotation is 1.32 s, so every
# benchmark completes 7-31 rotations on index 0 and nothing is too short. Measured
# per-line runtimes are preserved in cmdline_times.tsv if this ever needs revisiting.
